title: Paper 2 case study recall grid and revision plan template
subject: Geography
source: Seeded from geography/y11 lesson 45 (Paper 2 case study recall grid and revision plan template (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 45: Paper 2 case study recall and the plan to the exams. To understand how to secure Paper 2 case studies and follow a realistic revision plan to the exams

questions.q: Give two figures for your developing-country city case study.
questions.a: Pupil's own accurate figures (e.g. population, growth rate)
questions.model: I picture my card. City, country, population. One problem with a figure.

questions.a: Questionnaire, land use survey, environmental quality survey, pedestrian count

questions.q: Complete the Paper 2 case study recall grid from memory, then correct in a second colour.
questions.model: Teacher completes the urban developed row aloud.

questions.q: own exam-style Section B: (a) State one hypothesis for a human enquiry. (1) (b) Explain one strength of using a questionnaire. (3) (c) Suggest how the enquiry could be extended. (4)
questions.a: (a) e.g. environmental quality improves with distance from the town centre (b) gathers views directly, with development (c) more sites, different times, secondary data

questions.q: Write your day-by-day plan to 26 May in the portal.
questions.a: A realistic plan with spaced retrieval and timed practice

questions.q: Big question: what will you do each day?
questions.a: A specific plan with daily retrieval and timed practice
